quotes.text: ACH or bank debits are only available for Instant Payouts after the payment has settled.
You’re limited to a maximum of 10 Instant Payouts per day.
The Instant Payout fee is pre-deducted so the balance shown reflects what you’d actually receive.
You must have an eligible payout account to receive Instant Payouts.

old_evidence.text: Stripe charges Dashboard users a 1% fee for all Instant Payouts for CA, EU, UK, SG, NO, HK and MY, and a 1.5% fee for US, AU, NZ, and AE.

answers.Q1: The 2026-11-07 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/instant-payouts is a full Dashboard-user guide. Eligible users with a positive, eligible balance and configured card or bank destination request through Dashboard, qualified mobile or the API using method=instant and destination. Balances API instant_available reflects eligible funds, including completed card charges and bank debits only after settlement, adjusted for fees and limits. New users are not immediately eligible. The guide specifies a maximum of ten Instant Payouts per day and a separate account-specific maximum daily payout amount visible in the Dashboard. A payout counts toward the regional daily allowance at request time even if it arrives on another day (new raw lines 135-157). The capture does not specify how failed requests affect the count. Arrival is typically within 30 minutes (new raw lines 9-19, 62-168 and 194-220). May documents the same behavior and 36 listed countries; source-stripe-payouts-instant.md says 37 and treats timing too absolutely. The May guide quotes regional 1% or 1.5% fees while November retains the fee and deduction with no percentage (old raw lines 20-59 and 162-195; new raw lines 21-60 and 159-192).
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/instant-payouts, the substantive change is pricing coverage: November retains per-payout fees, balance pre-deduction and unchanged currency transaction minimums and maximums but omits May's 1% and 1.5% rates (old raw lines 169-195; new raw lines 166-192). This does not establish a new or zero rate. The reciprocal Payouts concept should preserve distinct fee bases: Instant Payouts uses a per-payout fee, while the November Next-Day guide quotes a monthly percentage of prior accelerated charges without specifying the rate. A current relative cost is unverified. The Node-to-curl examples, renumbering, settings links and extra Connect backlink are presentational or navigational. Keep May's dated rates and both raws in source-stripe-payouts-instant.md. Correct 37 to the same 36 published entries in each capture, maintain typical arrival and account-specific requirements, and preserve the reciprocal Stripe Payouts route plus separate next-day, bank lookup, advance-funding and Connect routes (old raw lines 8-18, 20-59 and 197-223; new raw lines 9-19, 21-60 and 194-224).
